verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI (Ramp Intelligence, agents, auto-categorization), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy, or contractual commitment preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. The MCP role restrictions and OAuth scopes control access, not training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
